description: Explicit SDL fallback-renderer capture after a native-outline request. A yellow legacy geometry outline visibly marks the player in the fallback-style frame; renderer state is recorded by the capture controls.

review.notes: The yellow legacy outline is clearly visible in a fallback-style frame. SDL history and the native request are not visible, so the caption records them as capture state rather than a pixel-only claim.

title: Legacy outline on the SDL fallback renderer
